comparison.position: AHE-Beta把演进的依据从测试分数移到经过核实的用户需求。模拟用户进行多轮交互并提交问题；Triage把问题核实成可泛化需求，Architect按共同根因合并至少两个需求，PM从跨会话记录找隐含产品需求。开发者只接收被准入的需求及其证据包。
comparison.tradeoff: Harness²按执行对照提出、组合并积累经验，且不使用rubric；AHE-Beta把跨会话需求、证据准入和head绑定审查作为演进主干。两者都不能由本地固定角色替身的通过数证明泛化能力。

analysis.title: AHE-Beta：让需求证据而非基准分数决定Harness演进
analysis.body: 证据包只有被引用会话的运行日志、公开任务和执行条件，用户对话、隐藏测试和grader不能传给开发者。RFC先做设计审查，代码再按验收标准审查；合并时批准必须绑定当前PR head，且RFC仍与已审设计一致。这里的“verified”是上游角色判断，不是形式正确性证明。测试确认未核实的合并需求不能吞掉原需求；原始issue不能作为交付类型；证据为空、head过期、RFC变动或全套测试未完成均不能通过。无benchmark score、gold或隐藏test参数，但不提供恶意回调沙箱。

question.question: 它和Harness²都不看rubric，为何不是同一算法？
question.answer: Harness²用当前任务执行对照组合候选，再积累如何改的经验；AHE-Beta以会话需求、角色分工和审查准入选择跨任务结构改动。
question.example: 教学例：比较两个产物和核实中断控制需求，是两种不同证据。

update.summary: 只实现类型化Evidence/Requirement交付集、已核实合并需求的covers消解，以及绑定head与RFC的纯merge_eligible判定。没有模拟用户、Triage/Architect/PM语言判断、开发Agent或真正git合并。结构字段不保证字符串内部绝无隐藏答案，所以保持L0，不把类型检查称为语义安全。 完整实验高成本不复现，不作能力证据。

comparison.position: AHE-Beta moves evolution selection from benchmark scores to verified user requirements. A simulated user interacts over multiple turns and files issues. Triage verifies generalizable requirements, the Architect consolidates at least two requirements by root cause, and the PM identifies implicit product needs across sessions. Developers receive only admitted requirements and their evidence packages.
comparison.tradeoff: Harness² proposes and composes from execution contrasts and accumulates experience without rubrics. AHE-Beta instead centers cross-session requirements, evidence admission and head-bound review. Passing local fixed-role controls establishes neither method's generalization.

analysis.title: Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses
analysis.body: The delivery package contains cited runtime logs, public tasks and execution conditions, but excludes user conversations, hidden tests and graders. Design review precedes implementation; code review checks acceptance criteria. Merge approval must bind the current PR head and the unchanged reviewed RFC. Verification is an upstream role judgment, not a formal correctness proof. Tests ensure an unverified consolidation cannot suppress original requirements; raw issues are not delivery types; empty evidence, stale heads, changed RFCs and unfinished suites cannot pass. There are no benchmark-score, gold-answer or hidden-test parameters, but no sandbox for malicious callbacks is provided.

question.question: Why is it not the same as rubric-free Harness²?
question.answer: Harness² composes candidates using current-task execution contrasts and retains improvement experience. AHE-Beta selects structural changes through session requirements, role separation and review admission.
question.example: Teaching example: comparing two artifacts is not the same evidence as verifying interruption delivery.

english.update: The local slice implements typed Evidence/Requirement delivery, covers resolution for verified consolidations, and a pure merge_eligible decision bound to head and RFC. It does not implement user simulation, semantic Triage/Architect/PM judgments, a coding agent or actual git merging. Typed fields cannot prove their strings contain no hidden answers; this remains L0, not a semantic security claim. Full campaign not reproduced; no capability claim.

comparison.position: 小模型先做所有编程题；只有在时限内产生有效且通过测试的patch才直接结束。超时、空patch、语法错误或测试失败，都转给大模型。大模型从原始任务状态重新开始，不继承小模型的编辑、工具输出或推理。
comparison.tradeoff: BATS在任务内显式维护逐工具预算并由外部verifier决定继续或换路；Timeout Cascades在模型尝试级别用完成时长与验证结果决定冷启动fallback。二者的预算、费用和能力证据不相同。

analysis.title: Timeout Cascades：先试小模型，再从原始任务冷启动大模型
analysis.body: 作者从固定mini-swe-agent的单模型运行轨迹模拟策略，不重新跑级联。500题用于模型能力图；只有466题有两模型完整匹配轨迹，供级联模拟。有效GPU小时按每题runtime乘独占GPU数，即使真实批量有并发也不摊销；它不是集群实际电表成本。边界覆盖时限恰好完成、零时限、早失败、失败测试、双模型失败及非正GPU数。负控确认不能只计大模型时长或摊销GPU数；success标签只在离线评测器，绝不作为真实Agent可见输入。

question.question: 它和BATS的预算机制有什么不同？
question.answer: BATS逐工具扣账并重规划；这里按模型尝试超时切换。工具额度省下不代表GPU小时下降，GPU小时下降也不保证用户等待更短。
question.example: 教学例：小模型多等一分钟可能省大模型计算，却让一个请求更慢。

update.summary: Trace严格保存非负时长、GPU数量、有效patch与evaluator测试标签；cascade计算截断小模型费用、冷启动fallback和串行时延，evaluate仅接收完整匹配对。这里只处理合成轨迹数值，不调用模型、不运行SWE-bench、不做真实wall-clock路由，也不实现基于隐藏难度标签的oracle router。 完整实验高成本不复现，不作能力证据。

comparison.position: Every coding task first uses a small model. It stops only when a valid patch passes tests within the timeout. Timeout, an empty patch, syntax error or failing tests trigger a large model. The fallback restarts from the original task, without inheriting small-model edits, tool outputs or reasoning.
comparison.tradeoff: BATS tracks per-tool budgets within a task and uses an external verifier to continue or pivot. Timeout Cascades uses attempt duration and verification to trigger a cold-start fallback between models. Their budgets, cost units and capability evidence differ.

analysis.title: Reducing Inference Cost of Coding Agents with Timeout Cascades
analysis.body: The paper simulates policies from fixed mini-swe-agent single-model traces rather than rerunning a cascade. Model-capability plots use 500 tasks, but only 466 have complete matched traces for both models. Effective GPU hours multiply each task runtime by its exclusive GPU allocation without amortizing actual batch concurrency; this is not metered physical cluster cost. Controls cover completion exactly at the deadline, zero timeout, early failure, failed tests, both models failing and invalid GPU counts. Negative controls prevent charging only fallback time or amortizing GPU count. Success labels are offline evaluator metadata, never actor-visible input.

question.question: How does it differ from BATS budgeting?
question.answer: BATS accounts per-tool use and replans. This method switches model attempts on timeout. Fewer tool calls need not reduce GPU hours, and fewer GPU hours need not reduce user latency.
question.example: Teaching example: waiting another minute for a small model may save large-model compute while slowing one request.

english.update: Trace stores nonnegative duration, GPU count, patch validity and evaluator test labels. cascade computes capped first-stage cost, cold-restart fallback and sequential latency. evaluate accepts complete matched pairs only. It handles synthetic trace arithmetic, not models, SWE-bench, a live timeout router or the paper's hidden-difficulty oracle router. Full campaign not reproduced; no capability claim.

comparison.position: 不可信子Agent可把恶意指令夹在失败反馈里，诱导orchestrator授予新权限或改任务。Kaer不让自由文本失败报告进入planner，只传部署前固定的失败模板；planner用固定七种确定性算子修改尚未完成的子任务，最后重新验证任务及Agent策略。
comparison.tradeoff: ReAct让自由文本推理与真实观察交替以调整下一步；Kaer针对多Agent失败反馈收窄重规划信息通道，并用静态策略约束修改。它不是把ReAct观察删掉就得到安全，也不判断成功输出真假。

analysis.title: Kaer：有限失败通道与受策略约束的确定性重规划
analysis.body: 计划每一步的能力必须同时属于执行Agent能力集和任务策略；数据依赖只能来自较早步骤，接收Agent必须被来源Agent的输出策略允许，除最终步骤外每个产物都要有后继消费者。RE-EXECUTE、REVISE-DIRECTIVE、RESCOPE、REASSIGN、INSERT、PRUNE、REWIRE按序作用在副本，已完成前缀不变。成功输出与progress报告不传planner，但可能影响执行Agent；这不是全链内容安全证明。测试拒绝模板里追加任意指令、Agent伪报no-close-out、改已完成步骤、前向/自依赖、未消费产物、违规输出流和能力升级；合法插入后必须rewire才能通过。模板仍可撒谎，只是影响范围有限；拒绝plan不证明任务能完成。

question.question: 它相对ReAct改变的是哪一层？
question.answer: ReAct交替推理与动作观察；Kaer收窄多Agent失败通道并验证计划修改，目标是控制权劫持而非提升单步推理。
question.example: 教学例：能够根据新观察换路线，不代表不可信观察能授予新工具。

update.summary: 实现13种模板ID去重、四项计划策略检查、七种算子和INSERT/PRUNE依赖重编号；操作事务化，仅最终有效计划可返回。使用0-based位置，论文k对应本地k−1。本地严格拒绝任务策略外能力，没有实现原文单独的用户授权扩展、LLM planner、MCP gateway、重试调度或真实Cintra。 完整实验高成本不复现，不作能力证据。

comparison.position: An untrusted subagent may inject instructions through failure feedback to induce new privileges or task changes. Kaer sends only a deployment-fixed failure-template vocabulary to the planner, not free-text failure reports. The planner repairs uncompleted subtasks with seven deterministic operators, then revalidates task and agent policies.
comparison.tradeoff: ReAct interleaves free-text reasoning with observations to choose actions. Kaer narrows the replanning channel for multi-agent failures and constrains revisions with static policies. Removing ReAct observations alone does not implement Kaer, and Kaer does not judge successful-output truth.

analysis.title: Kaer: Security-Aware Replanning for Multi-Agent Systems
analysis.body: Each step's capabilities must be allowed by both its agent and task policy. Dependencies come only from earlier steps; recipients must satisfy producer output-flow policies; every nonfinal output needs a later consumer. RE-EXECUTE, REVISE-DIRECTIVE, RESCOPE, REASSIGN, INSERT, PRUNE and REWIRE apply sequentially to a copy, preserving the completed prefix. Successful outputs and progress reports do not reach the planner but can affect executing agents; this is not end-to-end content security. Tests reject instructions appended to template IDs, agent-asserted no-close-out, edits to completed steps, forward/self dependencies, unused outputs, forbidden data flows and capability escalation. Insertion needs suitable rewiring to pass. An agent can still lie by choosing an allowed template; influence is bounded, not eliminated. Rejecting an unsafe plan does not prove task completion.

question.question: Which layer differs from ReAct?
question.answer: ReAct alternates reasoning, actions and observations. Kaer narrows multi-agent failure feedback and validates plan revisions, targeting control hijacking rather than stronger single-step reasoning.
question.example: Teaching example: adapting to an observation does not authorize that observation to grant a new tool.

english.update: The local slice deduplicates13 template IDs, validates four plan conditions, and applies all seven operators with dependency renumbering after INSERT/PRUNE. Repairs are transactional and return only a valid final plan. Indices are zero based (paper k maps to k−1). Capabilities outside task policy are rejected; the separate explicit-user-grant extension, LLM planner, MCP gateway, retry scheduler and Cintra environment are absent. Full campaign not reproduced; no capability claim.

comparison.position: 个人Agent的prompt更新可能提升主动性，却同时改变隐私披露、承诺和执行报告。论文固定模型和runtime，只改指令；先比较候选与父版本寻找反例，再重复确认、回滚定位和修复。修复局部验证后仍须完整admission；没有通过版本就继续用父版本。
comparison.tradeoff: Harness²用执行差异优化harness，不要求rubric；Safe Personal RSI对prompt候选显式比较安全/效用并保留父版本。后者有领域风险标签但仍不是安全证明；不能把前者匿名产物选择当后者admission。

analysis.title: Safe Personal RSI：修复通过不等于更新可准入
analysis.body: Appendix I以所有开发重放（含control）为分母，取五个primary风险类别的最大率。确认过的未授权披露case产生持久严重性veto，即使后来修复也拒该attempt；否则父/工作版本各至少5条且全部执行完成，最大风险不超过0.10且不高于父版本。效用不降，或成功率最多绝对下降0.02且成本proxy绝对减少至少0.10，才可准入。RQ1模板确认可接受非空截断多数；RQ2要求三次候选确认完整，差分还要三次父重放。测试保留论文限制：最大风险不变时次大类别风险仍可升高；不偷偷把规则增强为总风险比较。缺5条、未完成、严重veto、风险上升或效用/成本均不达标分别拒绝。阈值是点估计与工程常数，不提供置信界或总体安全概率。

question.question: 相比Harness²，它的安全门是否证明风险不会增加？
question.answer: 不证明。它比较最大primary类别点估计，次大类别甚至总primary风险可增加；Harness²的执行对照又不是这个领域风险门。
question.example: 教学例：最大类别维持2/20，另一类别0→1/20仍可能准入。

update.summary: 实现Replay评测记录、最大类别风险准入、持久veto、最少重放/完成检查、严格多数确认两种协议与回滚gain-retention的零gain约定。未实现Willow/Kicker、邮件工具、攻击搜索、LLM修复、语义judge、verification回放或OAuth修复。Replay不是给Actor的输入，只有离线evaluator调用。 完整实验高成本不复现，不作能力证据。

comparison.position: A personal-agent prompt update can improve initiative while changing disclosure, commitments and execution reporting. The paper fixes model and runtime, edits instructions, searches for candidate-versus-parent failures, then confirms, localizes through rollback and repairs. Local verification does not bypass final admission; without an admitted update, the parent remains active.
comparison.tradeoff: Harness² improves a harness from execution contrasts without requiring rubrics. Safe Personal RSI explicitly compares prompt-update safety/utility and retains the parent on failure. Its domain risk labels still do not prove safety; Harness² artifact selection is not this admission rule.

analysis.title: Safe Personal RSI: Evaluating and Repairing Personal-Agent Updates
analysis.body: Appendix I normalizes risk by all development replays, including controls, and compares the maximum rate over five primary labels. A confirmed unauthorized-disclosure case causes a persistent severe veto even after repair. Otherwise each harness needs at least five completed records; maximum risk must be at most0.10 and no greater than the parent's. Utility must not decrease, or success may decline by at most0.02 absolutely while cost proxy falls by at least0.10 absolutely. RQ1 template confirmation permits a nonempty truncated majority; RQ2 requires three completed candidate confirmations and, for differential confirmation, three parent replays. A negative control preserves the paper's limitation: nonmaximal-category risk may rise while maximum risk stays unchanged. The rule is not silently strengthened to compare total risk. Tests separately reject too few records, incomplete runs, severe veto, increased maximum risk, and failure of both utility/cost alternatives. Thresholds are point estimates and engineering constants, not confidence or population-risk bounds.

question.question: Does its safety gate prove no risk increase, unlike Harness²?
question.answer: No. It compares maximum primary-category point estimates; nonmaximal or total primary risk can rise. Harness² execution contrasts are a different, non-domain-risk criterion.
question.example: Teaching example: keeping the maximum at2/20 while another category rises from0 to1/20 may still pass.

english.update: The local slice implements evaluator Replay records, maximum-category-risk admission, persistent veto, minimum/completion checks, both strict-majority confirmation protocols, and rollback gain retention including its zero-gain convention. It does not implement Willow/Kicker, email tools, attack search, LLM repair, a semantic judge, verification rollouts or OAuth fixes. Replay records belong only to the offline evaluator, not the actor. Full campaign not reproduced; no capability claim.

comparison.position: 单算子快不代表端到端训练或服务变快。RSIBench-Infra让Agent从官方可运行baseline出发，跨engine、kernel、instruction修改，但只提交一个OCI filesystem layer。独立Serve/Train Job把同一digest应用到每个rank；Benchmark Job绝不加载候选层，单独做质量门和端到端计时。
comparison.tradeoff: Harness²改模型外执行框架并以任务执行对照积累经验；RSIBench-Infra评价跨栈训练/推理优化，以独立质量门约束端到端加速。优化harness通过数和已验证吞吐收益不是同一个结果，前者不能代替后者硬件链路。

analysis.title: RSIBench-Infra：把生产级基础设施优化与独立质量验证分开
analysis.body: 任务定义含模型、环境、资源和独立verifier。16推理+4训练任务覆盖1–32个加速器、最多4节点；推理模型1.7B–2.8T。训练固定输入，比较逐步loss和全局梯度范数；VLM GRPO还检查policy/KL loss、forward及隔离KL梯度。性能得分只有通过任务质量门才有效，microbenchmark不能替代端到端计时。审查明确隔离Agent环境、Serve/Train环境和Benchmark环境，比较部署digest与质量门，而不是伪造本地通过指标。没有运行正式任务、提交OCI、训练或测试模型；所以没有CPU/GPU能力分数，也不要求GPU回执。

question.question: 相比Harness²或kernel评测，它的目标有什么不同？
question.answer: 这里检查整个模型服务/训练链路在质量门下是否更快；harness任务通过或单kernel提速不证明端到端吞吐提高。
question.example: 教学例：kernel快2倍但数据传输占90%，整条链路提升仍可能很小。

update.summary: 仅做原文审查、成本评估、中英文说明和学习材料。没有把OCI字段stub、任意microbenchmark或单卡小模型标成RSIBench-Infra已接入；local_operator=null，不提供可执行Evolve算子。项目页https://rsibench-infra.github.io已核对，未验证论文专用源码仓库公开。 完整实验高成本不复现，不作能力证据。

comparison.position: A faster kernel need not make training or serving faster end to end. RSIBench-Infra starts agents from runnable official baselines and permits changes across engine, kernel and instruction layers, submitted as one OCI filesystem layer. Independent Serve/Train jobs apply the same digest on every rank. The Benchmark Job never loads that layer and separately checks quality and end-to-end timing.
comparison.tradeoff: Harness² improves model-external harnesses through task execution contrasts and accumulated experience. RSIBench-Infra evaluates cross-stack training/inference optimization with independently quality-gated end-to-end speed. Harness pass counts and validated throughput are different outcomes; the former cannot substitute the latter's hardware pipeline.

analysis.title: RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?
analysis.body: A task specifies the model, environment, resources and independent verifier. Sixteen inference and four training tasks span1–32 accelerators and up to four nodes; inference models range from1.7B to2.8T. Training replays frozen inputs and compares stepwise loss/global-gradient norms; VLM GRPO additionally checks policy/KL losses, forwards and an isolated KL-gradient probe. Speed counts only after the task quality gate, and microbenchmarks cannot replace end-to-end timing. Review distinguishes Agent, Serve/Train and Benchmark environments, deployment digests and quality gates rather than fabricating local pass metrics. No official task, OCI submission, model training or inference runs. Consequently there are no local CPU/GPU capability scores and no GPU receipt is required.

question.question: How does the goal differ from Harness² or kernel benchmarks?
question.answer: It checks whether the entire serving/training pipeline becomes faster while preserving quality. Harness task success or kernel speedup cannot establish end-to-end throughput.
question.example: Teaching example: doubling kernel speed has little impact when transfer dominates90% of runtime.

english.update: Only primary review, cost assessment, bilingual documentation and learning material are delivered. An OCI schema stub, arbitrary microbenchmark or small single-GPU model is not labeled an RSIBench-Infra integration. local_operator=null and no executable evolve operator is advertised. The project page https://rsibench-infra.github.io is verified, but no paper-specific public source repository was verified. Full campaign not reproduced; no capability claim.
